response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced full-stack and systems engineer with strong web, mobile, and DLang expertise, but his profile is fundamentally misaligned with this role's core requirement of deep, current C++ development for industrial automation platforms. His C++ experience is minimal (a brief 6-month stint in 2014-2015 and a bachelor's thesis project) and over a decade old, with no evidence of STL mastery, multi-threading, message brokers, MQTT, IEC 62443 security standards, or industrial protocols. His recent career trajectory has moved decisively toward JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js web development, away from systems-level C++ work.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level engineering experience (14+ years) with strong ownership and mentoring track record
Demonstrated experience with distributed, high-performance, low-latency systems (DLang, async I/O, microservices at Dunnhumby)
Strong communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source project leadership
concerns: C++ experience is minimal, outdated (2014-2015), and not a recent focus of his career
No evidence of experience with IEC 62443, SDL practices, or industrial cybersecurity standards
No demonstrated background in MQTT, message brokers, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.), or IoT/automation domains

key_factors.factor: Strong general software engineering seniority and distributed systems background
